sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher, and I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是詹娜·费舍尔，我是安吉拉·金西。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together, and we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演过《办公室》，而且我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你带来终极的《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office
sentences.zh: 每周，我们将深入探索《办公室》的世界

sentences.en: with exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 带来独家访谈、幕后花絮以及大量闺蜜故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office Lady 6.0.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室女士》6.0版。

sentences.en: Hi there, Angela.
sentences.zh: 嗨，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Hey, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嘿，早安。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早安。

sentences.en: You were telling me a tale as I was warming up my coffee this morning about your mascara.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我热咖啡的时候，你跟我讲了一个关于你睫毛膏的故事。

sentences.en: Well, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 是这样的。

sentences.en: I walked in, said good morning to Sam, good morning to Jenna, hi to Matt on Zoom.
sentences.zh: 我走进来，跟萨姆说了早安，跟詹娜说了早安，在Zoom上跟马特打了招呼。

sentences.en: I go to use the restroom.
sentences.zh: 我去上洗手间。

sentences.en: I have a massive mascara clump on my cheek.
sentences.zh: 我脸颊上有一大团结块的睫毛膏。

sentences.en: Nobody.
sentences.zh: 竟然没人告诉我。

sentences.en: I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道。

sentences.en: I was in my own world getting my coffee ready.
sentences.zh: 我当时沉浸在自己的世界里准备咖啡。

sentences.en: Did you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: No, apparently I didn't look up for my phone when you came in.
sentences.zh: 不，显然你进来的时候我正低头看手机。

sentences.en: Apparently not.
sentences.zh: 显然是的。

sentences.en: But also, I guess Josh didn't notice when I said goodbye to him.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，我跟乔什道别时，他好像也没注意到。

sentences.en: I always give him a kiss goodbye.
sentences.zh: 我每次走都会亲吻他告别。

sentences.en: No, giant black clump of mascara on my cheek.
sentences.zh: 天呐，我脸颊上有一大团黑色的睫毛膏。

sentences.en: But pretty much this morning has been a little bit of a get-ready fail.
sentences.zh: 总之今天早上我有点诸事不顺。

sentences.en: I slept with my hair wet, so you know what I woke up to.
sentences.zh: 我湿着头发睡觉，所以你知道我醒来时是什么德行。

sentences.en: Your hair looks great for having slept with it wet.
sentences.zh: 以湿发睡觉的标准来看，你的头发看起来真不错。

sentences.en: Well, I tried to tame my hair all morning.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我整个早上都在努力驯服我的头发。

sentences.en: It looks great.
sentences.zh: 看起来真的很棒。

sentences.en: Oh, it's underneath.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是在下面。

sentences.en: Don't look at the back.
sentences.zh: 别看后面。

sentences.en: Okay, whatever.
sentences.zh: 好吧，管他呢。

sentences.en: Let it go.
sentences.zh: 算了吧。

sentences.en: Let go of the back of my head a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 我早就放弃管我脑勺后面的头发了。

sentences.en: But then also, I will hold on to makeup way past the time you're supposed to hold on to it.
sentences.zh: 但还有一件事，我用化妆品的时间总是远远超过它的使用期限。

sentences.en: Like my powder compact right now is just one tiny square that's left.
sentences.zh: 比如我现在的粉饼，就只剩一小方块了。

sentences.en: Most of it is broken off.
sentences.zh: 大部分都碎掉了。

sentences.en: And then I will smush what's left of the powder.
sentences.zh: 然后我会把剩下的粉末拼命挤压在一起。

sentences.en: And then, like, I'm not throwing that away.
sentences.zh: 反正就是舍不得扔掉。

sentences.en: Well, I was doing this with my blush as well.
sentences.zh: 我用腮红的时候也是这样。

sentences.en: And I had dropped it once, so I had a crack through it.
sentences.zh: 我以前摔过一次，所以上面有一道裂纹。

sentences.en: And it was getting a little precarious, but I still kept finding a way to use it.
sentences.zh: 虽然已经有点摇摇欲坠了，但我还是想方设法继续用它。

sentences.en: And this morning, I'm rushing because my hair is crazy.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，因为头发太乱我很赶时间。

sentences.en: And I grabbed that blush out of the drawer.
sentences.zh: 我从抽屉里抓起那盒腮红。

sentences.en: And I open it.
sentences.zh: 然后我打开它。

sentences.en: And all the inside of it has crumbled like a fine paper.
sentences.zh: 结果里面所有的东西都像碎纸屑一样碎掉了。

sentences.en: And it went all over.
sentences.zh: 弄得到处都是。

sentences.en: What are you just, like, blush confetti?
sentences.zh: 你这是弄成了腮红纸屑雨吗？

sentences.en: All over the sink, all over the counter.
sentences.zh: 水槽到处都是，柜台到处都是。

sentences.en: I had to change my top.
sentences.zh: 我不得不换了件上衣。

sentences.en: So I don't know what the lesson is, you guys.
sentences.zh: 所以各位，我也不知道这能说明什么道理。

sentences.en: Maybe just, like, when things are past their due date, let them go.
sentences.zh: 也许只是，比如说，当东西过了保质期，就随它去吧。

sentences.en: You know, this sounds like my New Year's resolution about, like, little fixes, big wins.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这听起来像我关于那种小调整、大收获的新年决心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like, if you fix that problem, then it won't explode on you later.
sentences.zh: 比如说，如果你解决了那个问题，它以后就不会突然爆发了。

sentences.en: Later, maybe it's okay to toss that very old blush.
sentences.zh: 过会儿，也许把那个很旧的腮红扔了也行。

sentences.en: I think it's three years old.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它已经三年了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, lady, my problem is that now I can barely see without my glasses.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你知道，女士，我的问题是现在我不戴眼镜几乎什么都看不清。

sentences.en: I cannot read at all.
sentences.zh: 我简直没法阅读。

sentences.en: You know, I already worry about the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我已经开始担心末日了。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I'm worried that I'm going to lose my glasses during the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 我担心在末日的时候我会把眼镜弄丢。

sentences.en: And then I'm not even going to be able to read a book during it.
sentences.zh: 然后到时候我连书都读不成了。

sentences.en: Oh, that'd be horrible.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太可怕了。

sentences.en: Can you imagine?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不能。

sentences.en: I worry that I'm going to be barefoot during the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 我担心在末日时我会光着脚。

sentences.en: And it's going to be like Die Hard, where he's running around barefoot,
sentences.zh: 就像《虎胆龙威》那样，他在里面光着脚跑来跑去，

sentences.en: trying to fight the bad guys.
sentences.zh: 试图与坏人搏斗。

sentences.en: This is another one of my worries.
sentences.zh: 这是我的另一个担忧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Shoes and glasses.
sentences.zh: 鞋子和眼镜。

sentences.en: Very important.
sentences.zh: 非常重要。

sentences.en: Well, I can't see my face when I put my makeup on anymore.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我现在化妆时都看不清自己的脸了。

sentences.en: And it doesn't matter if I use one of those magnifying mirror things.
sentences.zh: 而且不管我用不用那种放大镜都没用。

sentences.en: It's not enough magnification.
sentences.zh: 放大倍数根本不够。

sentences.en: So every morning when I do my makeup, then I put my glasses on and I see what I've done.
sentences.zh: 所以每天早上我化完妆，然后戴上眼镜，看看自己都画成了什么样。

sentences.en: And it's never great.
sentences.zh: 而且从来都没好看到哪里去。

sentences.en: Do you have to tone it down?
sentences.zh: 你得下手轻一点吗？

sentences.en: It's not the toning it down.
sentences.zh: 倒不是下手轻不轻的问题。

sentences.en: It's that like the eyeliner isn't in any way straight.
sentences.zh: 而是眼线根本就画不直。

sentences.en: It looks straight to me when I put it on in a blur.
sentences.zh: 在我模模糊糊画的时候，我觉得挺直的。

sentences.en: Or I will have like gobs of mascara underneath my eye and I can't see them until I put my glasses on.
sentences.zh: 或者我眼睛下面会有一团团的睫毛膏，在戴上眼镜之前我都看不见。

sentences.en: So I have to do my makeup, then put my glasses on,
sentences.zh: 所以我得先化好妆，再戴上眼镜，

sentences.en: and then go in with like a wet Q-tip and like fix everything.
sentences.zh: 然后拿一根湿棉签去把所有地方修正好。

sentences.en: I wonder what we're going to look like when we're old ladies.
sentences.zh: 我在想我们老了以后会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Like legit old ladies.
sentences.zh: 真正的老太太那种。

sentences.en: Like I think I'm going to have too much blush.
sentences.zh: 比如我觉得我以后会涂太多腮红。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Too much blush, too much lip.
sentences.zh: 腮红太多，口红太多。

sentences.en: And you're going to have like a lot of mascara globs.
sentences.zh: 而你呢，会有很多结块的睫毛膏。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: I feel the same way.
sentences.zh: 我也是这种感觉。

sentences.en: I don't mind.
sentences.zh: 我倒不介意。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Should we get into our fan chit chat question of the week?
sentences.zh: 我们要不要开始本周的粉丝闲聊问题？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Should we also say what we're here to discuss today?
sentences.zh: 我们要不要也说说今天来这儿要讨论什么？

sentences.en: I mean, we can.
sentences.zh: 我是说，可以啊。

sentences.en: You guys, we're going to get to it.
sentences.zh: 各位，我们马上就要开始了。

sentences.en: We're doing episode nine of the paper.
sentences.zh: 我们要讲的是《办公室》的第九集。

sentences.en: It's called Matching Ponchos.
sentences.zh: 这集叫做《同款斗篷》。

sentences.en: But first, let's have a chit chat.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，我们先闲聊一会儿。

sentences.en: This one's coming to us from Alexander G.
sentences.zh: 这条留言来自德克萨斯州大学城的亚历山大·G。

sentences.en: in College Station, Texas.
sentences.zh: 位于德克萨斯州大学城。

sentences.en: Howdy, Jenna and Angela.
sentences.zh: 珍娜和安吉拉，你们好。

sentences.en: I'm Alexander G.
sentences.zh: 我是来自德克萨斯州大学城的亚历山大·G。

sentences.en: from College Station, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我是来自德克萨斯州大学城的亚历山大·G。

sentences.en: My question for you guys is, if you guys have not pursued acting,
sentences.zh: 我给你们的问题是，如果你们当初没有追求演艺事业，

sentences.en: what would y'all's career be?
sentences.zh: 你们会选择什么职业？

sentences.en: I'm very curious to know you guys' answer to this question.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你们对这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: And love the pod.
sentences.zh: 并且很喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: Thank you, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，伙计们。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alexander.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历山大。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I thought that was such a thoughtful question.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个非常深思熟虑的问题。

sentences.en: I've thought about this.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过这件事。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I know my answer.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的答案。

sentences.en: Well, you should go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你先说。

sentences.en: I think I would be a vet tech.
sentences.zh: 我想我会成为一名兽医助理。

sentences.en: Oh, you'd be such a great vet tech.
sentences.zh: 哦，你会是个非常出色的兽医助理。

sentences.en: You have such a heart for animals, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你对动物太有爱心了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: I mean, those were the two choices I was weighing when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是我年轻时在权衡的两种选择。

sentences.en: I thought, do I want to become a veterinarian?
sentences.zh: 我想，我是想成为一名兽医？

sentences.en: Do I want to become a vet tech?
sentences.zh: 还是想成为一名兽医助理？

sentences.en: Do I want to become an actor?
sentences.zh: 还是想成为一名演员？

sentences.en: Right before I got my job on the office,
sentences.zh: 就在我得到《办公室》的工作之前，

sentences.en: I had just started doing rescue work with Kitten Rescue.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚开始在“小猫救援”组织做救援工作。

sentences.en: And they teach you, like, a lot of vet tech kind of stuff, you know, giving medications,
sentences.zh: 他们会教你很多兽医助理相关的技能，你知道的，比如喂药、

sentences.en: giving fluids, giving vaccines, being able to spot illnesses, things like that.
sentences.zh: 输液、打疫苗、识别疾病之类的。

sentences.en: There's a lot of that in the rescue stuff.
sentences.zh: 救援工作里有很多这样的内容。

sentences.en: And I really loved it.
sentences.zh: 而且我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: So I called my manager, Naomi, and my acting coach, Robert.
sentences.zh: 所以我给我的经纪人娜奥米和我的表演教练罗伯特打了电话。

sentences.en: And I said, you guys, I think I might want to make a change.
sentences.zh: 我说，伙计们，我想我可能想做出改变了。

sentences.en: If something doesn't happen this pilot season, I think I want to take some time off.
sentences.zh: 如果在这次试播季期间没有起色，我想休息一段时间。

sentences.en: I want to go to two years of vet tech school.
sentences.zh: 我想去读两年制的兽医助理学校。

sentences.en: I just, the acting thing is feeling like just eight years of rejection.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，演艺事业感觉就像是长达八年的拒绝。

sentences.en: Like, I'm just like, it has worn me down.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我真的被它折磨得精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it can be a real beat down.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的很打击人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And this other thing is giving me purpose.
sentences.zh: 而另一件事给了我目标。

sentences.en: It's making me feel joyful.
sentences.zh: 它让我感到快乐。

sentences.en: I feel needed.
sentences.zh: 我感到了被需要。

sentences.en: And I feel good at it.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我很擅长这个。

sentences.en: And I want to pursue that.
sentences.zh: 我想去追求这个。

sentences.en: And then I'll know, like, should I go back to acting?
sentences.zh: 然后我就会知道，我是不是该回去演戏？

sentences.en: But I might need to take like a sabbatical.
sentences.zh: 但我可能需要休假一段时间。

sentences.en: Well, as we know, I ended up going out for the office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我们所知，我最后去试镜了《办公室》。

sentences.en: And then everything sort of changed.
sentences.zh: 然后一切都变了。

sentences.en: And that path was the one chosen for me.
sentences.zh: 那条路是为我选定的。

sentences.en: But I've continued to do the animal rescue work.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在继续动物救援工作。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm fostering kittens right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我现在正在寄养小猫。

sentences.en: I mean, that's one of the first things I learned about you in our friendship.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们在建立友谊时我最先了解你的事情之一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You were fostering kittens the first time I went to your house.
sentences.zh: 我第一次去你家时，你就在寄养小猫。

sentences.en: Oh, is that true?
sentences.zh: 噢，是吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没，“对的”。（字面意：对的）

sentences.en: We had a screening of the pilot of the office.
sentences.zh: 我们当时举行了《办公室》试播集的放映。

sentences.en: And I had foster kittens.
sentences.zh: 而我当时有寄养的小猫。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: But I've been fostering and socializing little feral kittens for over 20 years now.
sentences.zh: 但我寄养并社会化那些野性小猫已经有二十多年了。

sentences.en: And I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: So I think if I wasn't an actor, that's what I would do.
sentences.zh: 所以我想如果我不是演员，我就会做那个。

sentences.en: And I think if I hadn't gotten cast on the office, I very well might be doing that right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我想如果我没有被选中出演《办公室》，我现在很可能就在做那个。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of doing it.
sentences.zh: 我其实也算在做吧。

sentences.en: Kind of doing both.
sentences.zh: 两样都在做。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You are.
sentences.zh: 你是。

sentences.en: You found a space for both things in your life.
sentences.zh: 你在生活中为这两样东西都找到了空间。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What about you, Sam?
sentences.zh: 你呢，萨姆？

sentences.en: Growing up, I really wanted to own a comic book store.
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，我真的很想开一家漫画店。

sentences.en: But I was alive when everything went to Amazon.
sentences.zh: 但我赶上了亚马逊崛起时代。

sentences.en: So there's no real physical print media anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上没有真正的实体印刷媒体了。

sentences.en: So you can't read.
sentences.zh: 所以你没法读了。

sentences.en: There's like five existing comic book stores left in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶现在大概只剩五家漫画店了。

sentences.en: There's one in the Valley our son has been to.
sentences.zh: 山谷里有一家，我儿子去过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The ones that have been there have been going for like 30, 40 years now.
sentences.zh: 那些开着的店都已经开了三四十年了。

sentences.en: But yeah, that's what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，那就是我想做的事。

sentences.en: Sam, have you been to Secret Headquarters?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，你去过“秘密总部”漫画店吗？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 我去过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's my home shop.
sentences.zh: 那是我的常去店。

sentences.en: I love Secret Headquarters.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢“秘密总部”。

sentences.en: So we're like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就像，对吧。

sentences.en: Shout out to Secret Headquarters.
sentences.zh: 向“秘密总部”致敬。

sentences.en: It's a, what all can you find there, Sam?

sentences.en: influences.
sentences.zh: 影响。

sentences.zh: 或者在满月时把什么东西埋在红石头下面。

sentences.zh: 如果大家发现自己惹上了梦魔，这里是你们可以采取的做法。

sentences.zh: 你可以用鼠尾草、香、圣水或圣盐来净化你的空间。

sentences.zh: 我想这盐必须是经过祈福的，因为这是个恶魔。

sentences.zh: 你也可以用圣盐泡澡。

sentences.zh: 说不定能在梦魔进入你的梦境之前把它网住。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 我也这么觉得。

sentences.zh: 但他只买了一杯，而且是专门给梅尔的。

sentences.en: And so they get in this crazy, weird fight about who should eat this ice cream soda and go back and forth about it.
sentences.zh: 于是他们为这杯冰淇淋汽水到底该谁吃而吵得不可开交，推来推去。

sentences.zh: 非常幼稚。

sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.zh: 戴夫分享说，这场戏里有一个很有趣的即兴发挥，他本来希望能够剪进正片里。

sentences.en: There was this moment, I guess, where Donal improvised actually eating the ice cream float.
sentences.zh: 我记得有这样一个瞬间，唐纳尔即兴表演了真的去吃那个冰淇淋苏打。

sentences.en: Like, he's like, fine, Mare, I'll eat it.
sentences.zh: 就好像，他说，好吧，玛尔，我吃。

sentences.en: And he downs it in, like, four spoonfuls.
sentences.zh: 然后他大概四勺就把它全吃光了。

sentences.en: And then Mare is shocked.
sentences.zh: 接着玛尔惊呆了。

sentences.en: And then he continues to try to make his case with her.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续试图向她陈述自己的观点。

sentences.en: But he has to stop because he has brain freeze.
sentences.zh: 但他不得不停下来，因为他脑子冻住了（头疼）。

sentences.zh: 戴夫说这真是一段极好的即兴表演。

sentences.zh: 他觉得太搞笑了。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: But he loved it.
sentences.zh: 但他很喜欢。

sentences.en: Maybe they'll get to do superfan versions of the paper.
sentences.zh: 也许他们以后能出报纸的超级粉丝剪辑版吧。

sentences.zh: 孔雀频道的超级粉丝剪辑版？

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They can add even more?
sentences.zh: 他们还能加入更多内容吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 好吧，内德和玛尔还在斗嘴，他们现在回到了停车场。

sentences.en: They're going to get in the car to drive back home.
sentences.zh: 他们要上车开车回家了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Mare is nominated for her Softies clogs Toledo story.
sentences.zh: 玛尔因她关于托莱多“舒适木屐鞋”的报道获得了提名。

sentences.en: But the entire paper is up for the overall excellence in journalism.
sentences.zh: 但整张报纸都入围了新闻业杰出综合奖。

sentences.en: And they are just elated.
sentences.zh: 他们简直欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They do a little happy dance in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 他们在停车场高兴地跳起了一支庆祝舞。

sentences.en: So I guess all is forgiven there.
sentences.zh: 所以我想那里的恩怨都一笔勾销了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.zh: 你知道吗，下一集，也就是季终集，就是俄亥俄州新闻奖颁奖典礼了。

sentences.en: We're going to see how this all plays out.

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then she says this whole speech where she's like, you have been kissed on the 17th day of the month.
sentences.zh: 然后她发表了一长串演讲，大致意思是，你在本月的第十七天被吻了。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: One last thing I want to share from Dave Rogers.
sentences.zh: 还有最后一件事我想分享，来自戴夫·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: I thought this was so sweet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太温馨了。

sentences.en: He said one of the highlights of the week of him directing this episode was that they got some very extra special VIPs that came to set.
sentences.zh: 他说他执导这一集的那周最精彩的亮点之一，就是有一些非常特别的贵宾来到了片场。

sentences.en: Jenna, you mentioned this.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你提过这个。

sentences.en: These are Dave's words, not ours.
sentences.zh: 这是戴夫的原话，可不是我们说的。

sentences.en: He said the lovely Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey, who I might add, got a huge round of applause from the cast and crew when they stepped onto the set.
sentences.zh: 他说，可爱的珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金斯利——我要补充一句，当她们踏上片场时，受到了演员和剧组人员的热烈掌声。

sentences.en: Some of the cast told me later they were both excited and nervous to meet you.
sentences.zh: 有些演员后来告诉我，他们见到你们时既兴奋又紧张。

sentences.en: But it was so nice having you guys there.
sentences.zh: 但有你们在真的太好了。

sentences.en: And those of us who worked on The Office, like Greg, Rusty, Kelly, Keisha, Veda, Steve, and Lori, and Sergio, and of course Oscar,

sentences.en: Aw.

sentences.zh: 那真的很特别。

sentences.en: It was such a great group of people.
